I came upon the scene shortly after a bee had become entangled. It was really interesting to watch because the other bees appeared to know what was up and were trying to help their comrade. When the spider would attempt to wrap up its captive the other bees would dive bomb it. At one point the spider retreating into a safer spot and the captive almost became free.
